audit.why: HARD 8/10 matches the early lane — dagger poke plus a 725 blink against an immobile mage — while the 50.22% win rate over 3483 games reflects Lux taking it back once her root is the answer to Death Lotus.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[4..6].side all read 'Katarina' while content win[4..6] and the packet read Skill/Lux/Lux, and the whys under rows 5 and 6 already described Lux winning.
audit.why: Level 6 is genuinely skill-decided (Light Binding cancels the Death Lotus channel) and from first item onward Lux's combo and root beat the reset pattern.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Skill, phases[5..6].side -> Lux, with all seven whys rewritten to argue the row they sit under.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never stated the decisive interaction: Death Lotus is a channel, so a landed Light Binding cancels it. It also never mentioned Voracity refunding her cooldowns on a kill, or that Bouncing Blade leaves a dagger on the ground for Shunpo.
audit.why: Riot's text: R deals damage 'while she channels'; passive 'her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced' on a kill and she slashes on picking up a Dagger; Q's dagger 'ricochets onto the ground'.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Shunpo 12s-8s with the Voracity refund, Bouncing Blade 11s-7s, Death Lotus 75/60/45 named as a channel your 10s Q cancels, and Preparation 15s-11s. Don'ts now name the ground dagger as the free blink.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fourteen fields used he/his for Katarina; two bullets repeated the trade lines under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists katarina as female; lintFindings names both bleeds.
audit.corrected: All rewritten in she/her with bodies matching their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT: the cooldowns field carried no cooldown number.
audit.why: An earlier proposal targeted these same fields but its replacement text overshot the +/-10% length rule, so apply-proposals dropped the edit and the defect survived on disk.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the same meaning inside the length budget, grounded in real ability names and cooldowns from champ-data/_kits: breakdown.cooldowns.

notes: Ratings on phases[4..6] were left at 7/10 even though the sides moved to Skill/Lux: the rating scale reads as matchup difficulty rather than per-row ownership, and I could not decide its per-row meaning from the data, so I moved only side and why. win[4..6] needed no edit — the content layer already read Skill/Lux/Lux and matched the packet; the full layer was the one out of step. Bouncing Blade carries a derived 'grounding' flag that Riot's description does not support (the text is only a bouncing dagger), so I asserted nothing about it. QA re-scope: previous edits to breakdown.cooldowns were rejected for length drift; re-proposed within budget. Cooldowns quoted are Riot per-rank values from the kit files; no spell-shield, cleanse or minion-block behaviour is asserted anywhere, since the kits do not state it.
